reflection: The notebook shows a consistent pattern: nearly every volume-based factor helps in 2023 and 2025 and hurts in 2022 and 2024, so none reaches 3/4 years alone. Pairs reach 3/4 years but add no synergy beyond the sum. The best single factors are AAPL-vs-QQQ volume contrasts, scaled by Apple volatility. Smoothing, down-market sign flips and QQQ stress variants all failed, so I will stop those directions. Next I will try to cut the 2022/2024 losses by making the volume signal regime-neutral, using ranks against a longer history and volatility-neutral scaling. I will also try a few different ideas, such as gap/close persistence and drawdown distance, and partners that supply the missing market-state information.

lessons.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_60d_down_market
lessons.lesson: Multiplying by the sign of QQQ's 10d trend flipped the volume signal's meaning half the time and destroyed the 2023/2025 gains, so trend-conditioning added noise.

lessons.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_60d_vol_scaled_smooth
lessons.lesson: Smoothing volume over 3 days and using a 60d vol normalizer removed the short-lived information in the daily volume surprise and lost in 2022 and 2024.

lessons.name: aapl_intraday_vs_qqq_intraday
lessons.lesson: Relative open-to-close move is mostly the same as the relative close-to-close move, so it gave tiny LR-only gains.

lessons.name: nvda_vs_msft_return_gap_lagged_mean
lessons.lesson: A 5d mean of the NVDA-MSFT gap duplicates NVDA 5d momentum and carries the same regime flipping.

lessons.name: qqq_down_day_volume_stress
lessons.lesson: QQQ volume signed by its 5d trend helped LR slightly but hurt RF and failed in 2022 and 2024, so the stress idea is unstable.

lessons.name: aapl_intraday_return_vs_range_position
lessons.lesson: Close-open location times volume surge gave a big 2025 gain for RF but lost in 2022 and 2024, so it is a high-variance regime-specific signal.

factors.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_60d_vol_scaled_ratio
factors.hypothesis: The 20d vol scaler is noisy in 2022 and 2024 turbulence; a 60d Apple volatility scaler is steadier and keeps the unsmoothed daily volume contrast that worked in 2023 and 2025.

factors.name: aapl_vs_nvda_volume_surge_range_scaled
factors.hypothesis: Scaling by today's range rather than 20d return vol makes the volume contrast adjust to the current day's turbulence, which may cut the 2022 and 2024 losses.

factors.name: aapl_drawdown_from_60d_high_vs_qqq
factors.hypothesis: The relative distance of Apple from its 60d high versus QQQ's measures Apple's relative strength over a longer horizon, which is not captured by the 20d factors and may anticipate mean reversion.

factors.name: aapl_gap_fill_persistence
factors.hypothesis: Whether the day's intraday move confirmed or faded the overnight gap shows who is in control (gap-and-go versus gap fade), which may predict next-day direction.

factors.name: qqq_range_compression_60d
factors.hypothesis: A short-term versus long-term QQQ range state tells the model whether the market is calming or heating up, the regime that flips the volume signal between 2022/2024 and 2023/2025.

factors.name: msft_nvda_return_vs_aapl_volume_confirm
factors.hypothesis: Peer outperformance versus QQQ, weighted by market volume, shows whether tech leadership is backed by participation and adds a directional component to the unsigned volume contrasts.
